claim: Before any release candidate is blessed, Patchline runs a rehearsal that walks the full reviewer-facing checklist as an ordered sequence of stages — capstone evidence, reviewer walkthrough, reproducibility replay, and documentation coverage — and the candidate is blessed only when every stage passes. A single failing stage blocks the candidate and names the first failing stage, so a release can never go out with a broken reproducibility replay or missing reviewer walkthrough hiding behind otherwise-green checks. The gate proves an all-green rehearsal blesses the candidate while a rehearsal with one injected failing stage is blocked at exactly that stage.
